title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: which product a new container record opens on
content:
## Scope

This policy of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category decides which product a per-container free-time record carries at the moment it opens, and when the import and export records open.

## Policy clauses

1. A record opens on the product that applies to the container at that moment.
2. It opens on AHL Contract Free Time 30 when the booking is rated under a service contract of the same customer whose tier rank is at least that product's lowest contract tier rank and which is active; otherwise it opens on AHL Tariff Free Time.
3. The service contract referenced by the booking must be active for a record to open on AHL Contract Free Time 30.
4. The equipment's rate class, taken from the product's equipment class map, must be one of that product's eligible rate classes; a contract booking whose equipment class is outside that list opens on AHL Tariff Free Time instead.
5. The export record opens when empties are released for the booking, and the import record opens when the container is discharged.
6. The other products (AHL Free Time Extension 3, AHL Free Time Extension 7, AHL Combined Free Time 14 and AHL Combined Free Time 21) are never applied at opening; they are bought later as upgrades.

## Evidence

The contract status is taken from the line's record of the service contract that the booking references, before the record opens.

## Decision table

| Booking rated under a contract of the same customer | Contract tier rank at least the threshold | Contract active | Equipment class eligible for AHL Contract Free Time 30 | Product at opening |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | yes | AHL Contract Free Time 30 |
| yes | yes | yes | no | AHL Tariff Free Time |
| yes | yes | no | any | AHL Tariff Free Time |
| yes | no | any | any | AHL Tariff Free Time |
| no | any | any | any | AHL Tariff Free Time |

## Points of judgement

**Q: A forwarder's booking is rated under a contract that is no longer active. Which product does the import record open on?**
A: AHL Tariff Free Time, because the referenced contract must be active for AHL Contract Free Time 30.

**Q: Can a record open directly on AHL Combined Free Time 14?**
A: No. That product is never applied at opening; it can only be bought later on a running record.

**Q: When does the export record of a container open?**
A: When empties are released for the booking; the import record opens when the container is discharged.
